nom: Rael Miracle Patch 3-Step Pore Melting Pack

avis.texte: This worked so much better than I expected! It loosened my blackheads without being harsh, and the soothing patch kept my skin from feeling irritated afterward. My nose looked smoother and my pores felt so clean. Definitely repurchasing!

This is such a new type of nose pore strip where it comes in a kit of multiple steps but the least irritating and it really does the job done and so satisfying to see all the gunk in my pores softening and being taken out!

avis.titre: So much better than biore strips
avis.texte: I used to use Biore strips all of the time until I found out they are actually so bad for your skin. This pore strips works so differently and way better in my opinion. It melts the congestion instead of ripping it out, so you wipe everything away with zero pain and zero redness. It also comes with easy to understand instructions and quite a bit of product.
What sorcery is this? Literally made all of my sebacious filaments and blackheads scrape right off. Amazing!
Works exactly as advertised. Left the first patch on for 15 minutes and the whiteheads couldn't wait to escape my pores. It was so gross and satisfying to get cleaned up.

I got this product for blackheads. It works really good to remove whiteheads and leaves your nose looking and feeling smooth. But it doesn't really work for blackheads and tbh blackheads become even more noticeable afterwards.

avis.titre: Rael Miracle Patch, best pore cleanser out there!!
avis.texte: Hands down, best pore cleanser. I was shocked and amazed! If you follow the directions, the patches hold this great product on your pores and literally chew gunk out of your nose!! I'm addicted!!
They completey dininish the apearance of the large pores and blackheads on my nose. I use them once a month to keep the spots away! Im a repeat buyer!

I use the Rael Pore Melting Pack for myself and my husband—it's our favorite way to clear out pores. I love seeing all the gunk it pulls out, leaving our skin feeling fresh and clean. Definitely a must-have for a deep detox!

I have cystic acne and my pores get clogged easily and its hard to extract black heads. The first sheet made my skin and the sebum really soft and makiable, the swabs have an extractor at one end, and the swab part is a slightly abrasive material that clings onto the gunk and pulls it out. The soothing sheet is a nice toner to calm thr skin after. My pores are empty! I used it on my nose and chin, and I'll be using it every week from now on ❤️

The first step makes your pores soft and pulls them to the surface but then the black qtips do nothing to get them out so what's the point. The last step I don't feel does anything either. If you use a regular pore strip after the first step, it helps gets things out. I just don't need all those steps if I'm gonna use the traditional strip anyways.
First off it was messy and time consuming but did nothing. The blackhead extractor is plastic so doesn't do anything to extract blackheads!
maybe I just don't have enough blackheads, but this product didn't really do anything for me. Which is surprising because I love everything that Rael makes! I use it for fun :)

Quite amazing!! Didn't hurt my skin like previous pore strips and really brought impurities to the surface. Both my husband and myself tried it and loved it. Love that its safe and healthy ingredients on my skin!! Also, NO REDNESS!!!! We went out to dinner right after, which was amazing!!
Gave it a three star because I've only used it once. It seemed slimy.

avis.titre: Great product and gentle on skin
avis.texte: Love the ingredients and the feel of this on my skin. It's really gentle but works very well. It doesn't yank ok everything like other products. Will be buying again
The 1st strip loosens the gunk in your pores so it falls out! The 2nd tightens pores and soothes redness.
does not clear pores at all my blackheads were all still there

Have tried these a few time. They sting upon application, which I assume is the peppermint. Not a refreshing tingle, more of a burning sting. Doesn't penetrate my pores at all, pore strips feel more effective and honestly, more gentl.
I really like these masks, they great for clearing out pores and then soothing in a such a better way than the normal strips that are so hard on my skin. I really like them!
Definitely works. Definitely would suggest anyone and everyone to buy some awesome product will be buying again
I gave this one a go not knowing what to expect. It didn't do much...I saw no difference except maybe some softening?

I received this product complimentary from the brand in exchange for my honest review. I think this is a really interesting kit for anyone concerned with clogged pores on their nose. I can't say I saw very dramatic results from using it, but it did seem to help clear my pores some. I'm mostly giving it 4 stars because I think it's a great alternative to the harsh pore strips that you have to rip off your nose. I like that this product targets the same issue but with chemical exfoliants. I did think the pore melting sheet was a tad harsh, but I like that they include a soothing step at the end. I'd say if you've got clogged pores on your nose and are considering stick-on pore strips, give the Rael kit a try instead!

I have pretty visible blackheads on my nose and I use this kit to soften, dissolve, and extract them. So far, I've noticed fewer blackheads and smaller pores on my nose after using this kit. My skin doesn't feel irritated the way it does with harsh chemicals or after physical extractions.

Once you get past the fact that these don't work the way that traditional pore strips work, the process makes more sense and is (dare I say it?) satisfying in its own way. Those with sensitive skin may want to skip on the step that requires some physical exfoliation as it could be irritating to some. Even skipping this step, the strips are effective at chemically doing what we expect pore strips to do.

avis.titre: Great product for blackheads that's easy on the sk
avis.texte: This product is easier on your skin than those that harden and peel off. It is a more time consuming process, and I'm not sure if the second cooling patch really did anything for my pores. Also, you may have a better q-tip lying around in your home. BUT, it's neat to see how they clean the pores and you take out the blackheads. Overall, it is fun to do and would be worth purchasing!

avis.titre: Different from expectation but great nonetheless!
avis.texte: I thought this product was a patch that would extract the blackheads as you pull it off. However, these patches contain a solution that sort of pulls it all to the surface and the enclosed tool helps to clean everything up. The tool worked wonders on my blackheads and the cooling patch was definitely necessary to help ease my sore nose from all the agitation.I definitely expected something different but still loved the product!

This blemish remover system was a hoot to try out! This kit comes with 3 separate applications that consist of a sheet to "melt" your pores, a step to remove any impurities the first step might have brought up, and another soothing sheet to help heal the area. The 2nd step was oddly satisfying with the special absorption tools provided. Overall this was an interesting experience that helped remove blemish buildup and concentration.
Does what it is supposed to do. I feel like my makeup looks better as well on my nose because if it!
i have try this 3 step pore masks and i love it has cleared out a lot of my pores and my skin looks amazy
I like it, I think it doesn't melt you're pores but it does help clean then out!
I was excited to try this because I've been struggling with blackheads and acne, it just didn't really work for me tho.

The concept of this product is cool. I actually do like it. It was fun using it on my self care night. However, I feel like this product did nothing for my blackheads on my nose. I've had better experiences with pore strips and think I will just continue using those.

This product did not amaze me or provide any crazy improvement in cleansing pores. However, immediately after use is when I would see the slightest improvement, after that, I'd wake up in the morning looking the same as before.
This product was three steps two nose mask and one disposable extractor i loved it and left my nose feeling clean and not irritated
I have pile skin and mostly on the nose covering all my pores and having black heads everywhere. This helped a lot !!
I quite enjoyed this pore mask it worked quite well at removing the black heads from my nose and didn't hurt at all

I was skeptical about trying these pore melting packs, but I thought, heck, why not? I'm so glad I tried them and gave them time! My pore are visibly smaller and my face looks smoother. The instructions were very easy to understand and I love that the kits came with tools to make it easier. I will definitely be repurchasing.
This helps remove clogged pores and blackheads. And it's simple three step and after your makeup and skin care will look better than ever.

Maybe if I had the rest of their products, this would've worked better for me. All I can really say about it is it made my skin smooth for about a day. The amount of gel product they put on the strips is a little much, and it can burn your eyes so be careful.
The product was so easy to use and so effective. Loved the ease of the instructions and the packaging. Great for a self care day!

When i used the 3 step pore melting pack i used it after i exfoliated in my skin care routine. I waited for 10-15 minutes in order to see my results once I saw them I realized that the pores shrunk meaning they were less noticeable which is what I love about it.

I have always dealt with blackheads and I have tried several things to be honest I did not believe in the product but wow it has left me speechless, it is a product that is not aggressive for the skin and still works. Of course I recommend it 100%, you can see my results !!

I always love trying new pore strips because I have a ton of black heads and large pores. This pore meeting pack was easy and fun to use, and I felt that my blackheads look reduced, as well as my pores!
I was a little hesitant about how efficient this would be. But it works wonders. Surely something I will continue using

I am super excited I got to this out but I find the other leading brands nose strips not only hurt, but don't do much for me.. I found that these definitely help. I love how they feel on my face, the slight minty tingle (almost like using noxzema) is comforting and soothing - and doesn't irritate my skin. These leave my nose super smooth and are easy to wear with my glasses!

This product left the skin around my nose incredibly smooth. Before putting on my makeup, I like applying this to even out texture. I find that after using it, my makeup is easier to apply. Unlike other face masks, you can move around comfortably without fearing that it'll slip and slide off your face. These sheets are non-drying and non-sticky which is another bonus. I would recommend these to a friend!

I really liked these alot . I included them in my skincare routine . after cleaning my face . I put them on made my nose feel very soft and I could tell made my blackheads little not noticeable . so overall I would tell my friends and family about these .

I liked the product and that it didn't leave me too greasy feeling like other nose straps I've used. If you want to get rid of those annoying black heads on the nose then I'd try this! Usually mine tend to go away for a while and then come back and after trying this they did come back but it wasn't too bad. Try it and see for yourself!

This kit was very easy to use and seems more effective than the other popular pore strips (which usually don't work for me). Step 1 had a tingly minty feeling, and a subtle minty scent. It really loosened up the gunk on my pores, and I was able to get a satisfying squeeze after. The swab wasn't very effective (the hole wasn't quite the right angle to squeeze stuff out) , but I appreciate that it's black so I can easily see impurities and with how small it is, I can stash it in my purse. I have super sensitive skin and step 1 and step 3 didn't irritate it at all! The soother mask really calmed down the redness, and I even use the leftover liquid as a serum. I was able to wear my glasses while using the masks. Definitely recommend this 3-step kit for anyone looking for a deep pore cleanse of the nose area!

This is a great product. I love how it has three steps. Most pore strips only contain one step and miss the other two critical steps, especially rehydrating afterwards like the soothing sheet. This product really made a different in the appearance of my pores and got a lot of the "gunk" out.
This is not your typical blackout head strip remover. If pretty much opens up the pore and you use the tool to get the black heads out. It worked great!
I'm not a huge fan when it comes to pore strips, it did take some black heads out but in my option none take them all off
I followed the instructions, but I honestly saw no difference in my skin with using this.
The 3 step pore pack was super cool, I ended up using one of them on my fiance and we were able to de-og his pores much better than with any other products we've used before.

When I received the opportunity to try Rael's 3-Step Pore Melting Kit I was so excited to try this out! My nose is always oily & quickly has blackheads which will forever annoy me. When I opened step one I immediately noticed that it was seemingly close to one of the wet paper masks. I followed the instructions in step one and the sheet kept falling off my nose. When I went in with the sebum tips I had to push down to get the debris up truly and used 2 in 1 go. The soothing step 3 felt just like a slimy mess and also kept falling off my nose. I did see a difference, however, it was still slight. It was a neat experience to have in the end. I wouldn't suggest it to others though.

This product felt nice and soothing, but i'm not sure if it was as effective as it claimed it was. Immediately after using all 3 steps, I noticed a difference, but when I woke up, it seemed as if I had blackheads return. However, it did feel really nice when I used the products

I've never used a nose mask system like this before, and I have to say it's life changing! The first mask is gentle and prepares my pores for the next step, the extraction tool. The tool is super effective and really gets the blackheads out of my pores. The last mask is soothing and a great way to finish the treatment. I will definitely continue with this pore treatment pack!

These are seriously incredible! I noticed a huge difference after one use. I would highly recommend this to anyone that struggles with nose pores. Pairing this with a good serum is absolutely killer. You can't even see the pores on my nose anymore.
I love this product! I have lighter skin that shows allllll my blackheads. I feel like I've tried just about everything and nothing had worked, but this product made a visible difference!
I've never really gotten into K-beauty before, and this was a nice experience. I definitely felt a difference after using it once, I will have to see how it is after the other 3 uses.

I felt like I wasted a lot of time doing these steps. 20 mins? To do a nose strips. Also step 2 smoothing mask formula was too runny. Some of the product kept on running down my mouth. I felt it was nothing on since it had no smell. However, I did like the black tip pore extractor side. I will definitely not repurchase this again.
I really like it, is a new product for me since the ones I have tried before it's one step.

The results from this pore pack were not super noticeable. I felt slight burning with the step one treatment, and didn't notice many blackheads coming out during the step two. My nose did feel a bit softer, but i don't feel like the results are that noticeable

I am so pleased with this product! Hands down it is the best pore strip I have ever used. I had always used those pore strips that harden on your nose and then you rip off and your skin is all dried out. These are NOT like those. The product consists of 2 packages of pre-moistened nose strips, and a couple of q-tip/extractors. The instructions are very clear and easy to follow. You first put on the pore melting strip for 10-15 mins. It stays moist the whole time, and has a rather strong, minty/menthol smell that really opens your sinuses. I was floored when I took it off and literally almost all my blackheads had just disappeared!!! There wear a few left around the base of my nose, which case out easily using the extractor tool. I then put on the soothing strip, which had a cooling sensation and left my nose feeling baby soft. I can not recommend this product enough!
This product loosened up my pores and made it so easy to remove and extract black heads!!

I received this product free from BzzAgnt in exchange for an honest review. I've never tried a product like this before and I was very happy with the results. You leave the little nose strip on for 15 or so minutes and then you use the included swab with black head remover which I thought as super cool. It really help clear up my nose and I plan to use this product a couple times a month part of my normal skin care routine.

Don't let the gentle removal deter you. This removed the blackheads in just 3 days! I noticed an improvement the first night but I didn't want to scrub my skin too hard with the cotton swab. The sheets are hydrating and definitely soothing after using the swab. It has a light peppermint scent. Even though it's sitting on the nose it isn't a very strong or irritating scent.

This is a great kit with multiple steps to tackle those enlarged pores. I found it gentle and easy to use. Definitely a great product for some self care. I took off one star because nothing happened for me when using the stick. It's not as satisfying as ripping off a pore strip.

avis.titre: Not sure what I was supposed to see...
avis.texte: Didn't appear to have any affects, irritated my skin, and I wish the cleaning swab could have shown a cleaning difference, but I couldn't tell that it was doing anything
It absolutely softened my blackheads and helped me remove a few but it wasn't enough for me to buy this product again. After the first use, the 2nd and 3rd didn't do much.

I actually really liked this product! After I went through all of the steps, the area was extremely smooth when my skin around my nose is a little rough between it being a little drier and larger pores. I can see this product being a great first step before makeup before taking photos because it really smoothed out the area of my nose where sometimes I have trouble with foundation being patchy because of the texture that is normally there. The instructions were easy to follow and the masks were fully soaked in product. The masks didn't slide around too much so I was able to still move around a bit without worrying about it sliding off and could multitask while doing the mask. It had a nice light fragrance that wasn't overpowering so if someone is sensitive to scents, I don't think this will be a concern. I think it is pretty reasonable priced for a 3 pack so I really am impressed overall.

avis.titre: It helped clear out my black heads
avis.texte: I love this. It dissolved and cleared out some black and whiteheads I had on my nose without pain. I love the soothing toner too. Overall I think it's an amazing product as it worked well on my skin. Give it a try

This didn't feel like it did enough. It softened my skin slightly so the blackheads were somewhat easier to remove. I also didn't feel like the 3rd step to sooth my skin did much of anything beyond hydrate.

I tried it in the morning and the evening, no real pore cleaning. Just a nice refreshing mask. The peppermint is great thought and the packaging is nice. It didn't seem to take any out as I was expecting, just minimized the size

This is actually effective. However, I am not really a fan of the 2nd step where the physical extraction is applied, it is a tad painful. The nose sheets are non-drying, and non sticky, which is a plus. I like that there are no parabens, no sulfates, and no fragrance added. It does seem effective, but keep in mind the step 2 if you don't like the physical extraction. Overall, it is effective indeed, much better than those sticky nose sheets.
So I was very excited to try this products because I have so many blackheads on my nose but sadly it only removed some of them not all
I love all Rael products, they work so well and this is no different! It works great and my pore have never felt clearer or smaller. I love all of their products!

I really love this three-step melting pack! The three steps of the process are very clearly labeled and it is super easy to have the first and third strips on your nose for a while while you were doing other things! The pic to clear out any remaining impurities does hurt a bit and made my eyes water lol but I definitely felt like my nose was super clean afterwards!

avis.titre: My new favorite pore melting pack
avis.texte: Rael Beauty's miracle patch: blackhead control is a 3-step pore melting pack and it is my absolute favorite! I struggle with blackheads and this product really helps me handle it. I would definitely recommend this to anyone who wants to get rid of their blackheads!
When I received this I was skeptical because I've tried all types of pore masks. When I tried this I was so surprised it worked so well my pores looked clear and so good.

avis.titre: melt the blackhead and clogged pores
avis.texte: thge nose strips work well in a gentle way. Although you won't have the satisfaction of seeing all the whiteheads pulled out, it's satisfying to see them melted from your nose pores!the cotton sqab help to get rid of the sebum and that is satisfying! My pore gets smaller instantly.

I tried this on my son first because he has a lot of little blackheads on his nose. I like that it wasn't sticky. We left it on and used the little stick after and his nose was softer but really didn't see any difference as far as the blackheads we're concerned. Not the best treatment for this as far as we could see.

I'm not used to a pore patch that doesn't pull off your skin. But this 3 step pore patch kit is really great. It's simple but effective. I live that it comes with cleaning/sebum cotton swabs. If I had to say one negative thing it would be, it's got a very strong smell.

I tried it and it felt minty refreshing it was a easy three step It left my nose feeling super smooth even super shiny It removed a lot of dirt and buildup from my pores I felt my pores where open and super clean I love this product and will be purchasing this brand on my own
I thought this was going to be your classic nose strip. But I stand corrected! Love it.

I really like this product. I think if you're a fan of pore strips, I would consider this product because it's made with better ingredients compared to other pore strip brands. I wish I knew if this was made in a more sustainable way, ex. clean packaging or clean supply systems. I would consider purchasing this again.
I felt like this product didn't do much. It was burning my nose a little and I didn't notice any pores really getting cleaned out.

I was honestly looking forward to this product as I had heard of it, I have tried several patches for the black spots on the nose but compared to these I think these made a big difference. As soon as I removed the last step of the application, I noticed that my pores were cleaner and the skin was softer and smoother. Although I forgot to take a photo, I assure you that they work, I highly recommend it and I will surely buy it when these are finished.
This product made me feel so much more confident and reduced the look of imperfections and pore size on my nose. I am going to be a regular purchaser of this product.
